verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench with desktop, web and terminal agents, and it advertises multi-agent goal planning, execution and verification. However, nothing in the evidence documents the agent writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts or updating dependencies. Generic coding-agent positioning does not show these specific capabilities.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me
